final_name.description: Got to Van Horn, and then head west to Fort Brennard. Plenty of Golden Current plants in the area surrounding it. [#2]
all_descriptions:
Head out of Blackwater on the road west by the stables, and you'll find the Great Plains are full of plants.
There's a couple of bushes full of golden currents below the 'A' in Blackwater on the map, just below the 'Broken Tree' writing, and another couple just under the tree itself. [#1]
Got to Van Horn, and then head west to Fort Brennard. Plenty of Golden Current plants in the area surrounding it. [#2]

Fast travel to Manzanita Post, and head north to the little triangular junction. There are some directly north, and then head south east to find some quite close to the corner of the junction where the roads meet. [#3]

final_name.description:
Hunt these at night only. Best spot is the trees just in front of Riggs Station.
You can also head to Rhodes and try in the woods just east of Mattock Pond.
Finally, south of the abandoned village of Pleasance is another place to try. [#1]
